target.title: fix(bash-tools-exec): fix regex pattern in validateScriptFileForShellBleed to detect single-character environment variables
target.body:
A regular expression error was found in the `validateScriptFileForShellBleed` function of the `src/agents/bash-tools.exec.ts` file.

<!--

For fixes, describe the user-visible symptom and trigger:

Avoid implementation details such as:

-->

## What Problem This Solves
The original regular expression `/\\$[A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]{1,}/g` requires matching at least 3 characters (`$` + a letter/underscore + at least one letter/digit/underscore), which causes single-character environment variables such as `$A`, `$P`, and `$_` to not be detected correctly.
